# EmptyState

Empty state: an icon or illustration, an explanation and a call to action. Use it when a list has no data, a
search has no results or nothing is selected.

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: Empty lists, searches without results, nothing selected in a split view, features not configured yet

## Import

```ts
import { EmptyState } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Explain why the area is empty and offer the next step.

```tsx
import { Button, EmptyState } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <EmptyState
      icon="project"
      title="No projects yet"
      description="Create a project to manage its tasks and documents here"
      action={<Button variant="primary">New project</Button>}
    />
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Small, inside a list

```tsx
import { EmptyState } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Small() {
  return <EmptyState size="sm" icon="search" title="No matching files" />
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | Main text: why this place is empty, such as "No projects yet". | — | No |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | Additional text: what the user can do next. | — | No |
| `action` | `ReactNode` | Call to action, usually a primary button. | — | No |
| `icon` | `IconName` | An icon instead of the default illustration (easier to understand when it relates to the content, such as a folder or a message). | — | No |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | Size: `md` for a whole page or a large area, `sm` inside lists and panels. | `'md'` | No |
| `fill` | `boolean` | Fills the height of the parent and centers the content. | — | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

118 values, listed on the [Icon](Icon.md#types) page.
